items.title: Final Fantasy XIV Patch 7.58 Notes and Changes
items.summary: Final Fantasy XIV Patch 7.58 brings regional matchmaking changes, a stronger Savage raid Echo, Crystalline Conflict Season 22, and gameplay fixes.
items.content:
Square Enix has released Final Fantasy XIV Patch 7.58, introducing adjustments to the Crucible of the Unbroken, increased Echo bonuses in AAC Heavyweight Tier (Savage), and the beginning of Crystalline Conflict Season 22. The update also removes several weekly reward restrictions, increases the drop rate of Wings of Nihility, and makes changes to Trust NPC experience gains and Free Company housing.

Same-region matchmaking is also being expanded to North American and European data centres, with the feature scheduled to become available soon. The patch additionally addresses several issues affecting the Crucible of the Unbroken, Keybound Brawler, Duty Roulette, and other gameplay systems.

items.title: Final Fantasy XIV Evercold Preorders Are Now Live, Includes Standard & Collector's Editions
items.summary: Square Enix has launched preorders for Final Fantasy XIV Evercold, which arrives in February 2027. Get more details here.
items.content:
Pre-orders for the Standard and Collector’s Editions of the Final Fantasy XIV expansion, Evercold, have gone live ahead of its highly anticipated launch on February 23, 2027. You can purchase it as a collector’s bundle, which includes a digital version of the game but only on PC, which is a little odd considering the whole point of no disc was to include digital codes for the other systems. The Collector’s Box, which is just the physical merchandise, has also launched. At the time of writing, the EU/UK versions are now live, with the NA store getting the box added later on in the day at 10AM PST.

The bundles in the UK are £239.99 for the Collector’s Box and £289.99 for the Collector’s Bundle, which for some reason is a different button for PC/MAC, so make sure you pick the correct one. Also, this is not a Steam code. If you are on a PC and wish to purchase the Steam version, make sure to buy the box and then buy the Collector’s Edition separately.

In addition, the console versions are sold separately too, so you will need to visit the PSN Store if you wish to purchase the standard or collectors edition of Evercold. However, note that the licence for the game is not shared, and you will need to purchase the expansion on any platforms you play on, the items are so you only need to purchase the Collectors Edition once if you do own the game on several platforms.

The digital collectors edition that you get when either buying the bundle or on its own, will include the following:

If you preorder any edition before February 23, you will gain access to the following:

If you get the pre-order in, then you will gain access to Evercold around 9AM GMT (subject to change also please convert to your local timezone) on February 19, rather than February 23. The earring also continues the trend of EXP increasing items; this item will give you +30% EXP from enemies you defeat as you level up to 100. Plus, the Wind-up Köttr Minion I feel like is going to be a fan favourite with a heap of players simply due to how adorable it is. items.title: Final Fantasy XIV Evercold Delayed, New Release Date Announced at FFXIV Fan Fest
items.summary: The MMORPG's next expansion was set to launch shortly after the new year, but Warriors of Light will have to wait a bit longer.
items.content:
Final Fantasy XIV Evercold was set to launch sometime in January 2027, which was announced as part of its initial reveal back in April this year during the North American FFXIV Fan Fest. However, this next expansion for the critically acclaimed MMORPG has been delayed – FFXIV Evercold's release date is now February 23, 2027 (and February 19, 2027 for early access). This was announced alongside the new, full trailer / intro cinematic for Evercold at FFXIV Fan Fest in Japan, and was said to only be a four-week delay.

In typical FFXIV fashion, the third and final teaser trailer is the full opening cinematic for an expansion, and it kicked off the Japan Fan Fest keynote where director and producer Naoki Yoshida presented more details on new features, where the ongoing story is headed, and fundemental gameplay changes as FFXIV goes into version 8.0 alongside Evercold's launch.

Pre-orders for Evercold open on November 4, 2026 and will come with a Wind-up Kottr minion to summon and follow you around in the world and Halone's Earring which will boost the EXP you gain for Jobs under level 100 when equipped. The collector's edition comes with the Valhallar Odin mount, the Entreat Crystal emote, and the Crystal Skyltborg which looks like glam for the new Bastion Job's weapons. The physical collector's bundle has the Evercold art book, the Tapestry of the Fourth decoration, a Kottr plush, a keychain of the Ethos Metal, and the Warrior of Light Reaper figure.

Additionally, we got a glimpse of the second new Job coming to his new expansion. It's a ranged DPS called Zephyr, which rocks a crossbow as their primary weapon and commands an avian companion to provide support.

There's a lot coming to FFXIV Evercold in addition to a new world and main story including a Neon Genesis Evangelion crossover raid series (which got a new teaser trailer) , a Final Fantasy VII crossover raid series, a new Tank Job with Bastion, and much more. Be sure to check out my Dawntrail review as well to look back at the last expansion before heading into this new era for FFXIV.

items.title: FF14 Reveals Four Week Delay Alongside Full Story Trailer
items.content:
Delay Evercold Final Fantasy XIV MMORPG Trailer

There was good and bad news at Final Fantasy XIV ‘s Japan Fan Fest . The bad news was that the MMORPG’s new expansion Evercold has been delayed by about a month. Originally set for sometime in January, the full launch will now arrive on February 23, 2027. The good news is that Evercold now has its third and final teaser trailer, a six minute cinematic that sets up the narrative stakes for Final Fantasy XIV ‘s biggest update in nearly three years.

“Tell me about the Promised Land,” a young girl asks early in the trailer. A wise old lady recalls a time of beauty and abundance that gave way to a “relentless ice” as magical beasts took over the mainland. People abandoned the continent for the skies above. The rest of the trailer is pretty much a ton of breathless views of massive city-sized airships (called Realmships) and cool battles showing off new job classes like the tanky Bastion who wields gunshields called Skyltborgs. Something that Square Enix doesn’t get enough credit for in its fantasy world building style is sneaking guns into stuff and making it look elegant and cool as hell.

The trailer also showed off the new DPS class called Zephyr, which wields a cross bow and a neat bird companion. It received its own breakout trailer giving fans a quick lowdown on how it will work. In fact, there were a lot of trailers to come out of the Japan Fan Fest. We got another teaser for the Neon Evangalion crossover event coming in 2027 as well as deep dives into the new locations and other changes coming with version 8.0 in Evercold . It will give players plenty to chew on as they wait a month longer for the full release.

Pre-orders for Evercold open on November 4, 2026 (there’s a trailer for the collector’s edition, too ). Those who pay for the pre-order (any edition) will get early access to the expansion starting Friday, February 19, 2027. While a four week delay isn’t a big deal, this does mean that February is now even more packed. Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis , God of War Laufey , Persona 4 Revival , and Fable all come out within a week of Evercold ‘s early access window. Should be fun!

items.title: Several Final Fantasy XIV Modding Communities Have Banned Popular NSFW Modder
items.summary: The bans came after modder Noffletoff was credibly accused of participating in graphic discussions of illegal content
items.content:
Several major Final Fantasy XIV modding communities have taken steps to remove the work of a popular not-safe-for-work mod creator after chat logs were exposed in which the modder was seen participating in graphic discussions of illegal material.

Content warning for discussion of child abuse sexual assault material (CSAM)

On YouTube, a user identified as Chunni Doll posted a video alleging that modder Noffletoff, along with several other Final Fantasy XIV players, was engaged in the discussion and sharing of CSAM. The video claims that the chats took place in an invite-only chat room that was part of a larger Matrix server centered on loli/shotacon content. (Sometimes described as an alternative to Discord, Matrix servers are decentralized servers that allow for real-time communication.)

The video was accompanied by a Proton document in which screenshots of the chatlogs are displayed. Kotaku has reviewed the document, and while direct references to victims’ names and explicit descriptions of CSAM content have been censored, the alleged participants can be seen making references to content they’ve watched and potentially sharing content with users on another platform called Session. Matrix administrators were made aware of the server and it was shut down and the alleged participants banned.

Noffletoff is the creator of several paid Final Fantasy XI V body and animation mods that are widely used to create NSFW FFXIV content. As a result of these allegations, numerous FFXIV modding communities are purging his work from their platforms. Additionally, Noffletoff’s Patreon and X account have been deleted.

The Final Fantasy XIV Mod Archive (XMA), one of the largest hosting sites of FFXIV mods, has banned the account associated with Noffletoff. Kotaku has reviewed messages sent in the XMA Discord server confirming Noffletoff’s suspension, a decision announced by a moderator after a user asked what would be done in light of the allegations. “I think it’s reasonable at this point to go ahead and suspend Noff’s account (and have done so),” the post read.

Kotaku has also reviewed messages in Booty Bay, a Discord server associated with pirating FFXIV mods. The moderators of that Discord server have taken similar action, removing his mods from their repositories while banning them from future uploads and banning all discussions related to the allegations against Noffletoff. Snowcloak, a Final Fantasy XIV mod program that allows users to view other players’ mods in game, will block the display of Noffletoff’s mods. “Users attempting to use these mods will receive a warning that the file is blocked,” read a message from a Snowcloak moderator, according to screenshots from the server reviewed by Kotaku .

According to the video, the alleged participants have been reported to authorities. Kotaku has reached out to Square Enix for comment.
